item.plank.name: Plank
item.ice_cube.name: Ice cube
item.ice_cube.desc: Cools your cargo: ice cream stays frozen for 180 s. In water it makes a small floe.
item.bait.name: Bait
item.bait.desc: Throw it: monsters chasing you go for it first.
item.water_jug.name: Water jug
item.water_jug.desc: Pours one tile of water: puts out fire, waters plants.
item.matches.name: Matches
item.extinguisher.name: Extinguisher
item.extinguisher.desc: Puts out fire in the three tiles ahead.
item.umbrella.name: Umbrella
item.umbrella.desc: Float down slowly: no fall can hurt you.
item.spring_shoes.name: Spring shoes
item.spring_shoes.desc: Bounce up one and a half tiles. Three uses.
item.horseshoe_magnet.name: Magnet
item.horseshoe_magnet.desc: Pulls one iron crate to you.
item.flare.name: Flare
item.flare.desc: Lights up the whole room for a while.
item.flare_diyu.name: Spirit lantern
item.flare_diyu.desc: Wandering souls back off. Lights the room and shows hidden coins.
item.hourglass.name: Hourglass
item.hourglass.desc: Rewinds 5 seconds: clock, cargo and hearts too.
item.seal.name: Seal
item.seal.desc: Seals a door, or holds a monster still for a while.
item.seal_diyu.name: Talisman
item.seal_diyu.desc: Holds one monster still for 5 seconds.
item.beacon.name: Beacon
item.beacon.desc: Drop it, then warp back to it any time.
item.map_piece.name: Map piece
item.map_piece.desc: Shows the door signs of the next two forks.
item.pocket_watch.name: Pocket watch
item.pocket_watch.desc: Monsters move only when you move. In puzzles the clock waits while you stand still.
item.whistle.name: Whistle
item.whistle.desc: Scares nearby monsters back one tile.
item.transfer_slip.name: Transfer slip
item.transfer_slip.desc: Use at a door sign to reroll its reward. The room type stays.
item.wish_bird_whistle.name: Bird whistle
item.wish_bird_whistle.desc: For Old Miner. Carried: in each new room, monster patrols show for 2 s.
item.wish_name_tag.name: Name tag
item.wish_name_tag.desc: For Zombie. Carried: at home he stops wandering and walks to you.
item.wish_whetstone.name: Whetstone
item.wish_whetstone.desc: For Goblin Smith. Carried: dig and pour sand 15% faster outside puzzles.
item.wish_family_photo.name: Family photo
item.wish_family_photo.desc: For Ancestor. Carried: souls within 3 tiles stop to look at you for 1 s.
item.wish_osmanthus_honey.name: Osmanthus honey
item.wish_osmanthus_honey.desc: For Meng Po. Carried: imps never steal your coins or sand.
item.wish_cinnabar_ink.name: Cinnabar ink
item.wish_cinnabar_ink.desc: For Judge. Carried: door signs also show the coins and monsters behind.
item.wish_candied_haws.name: Candied haws
item.wish_candied_haws.desc: For Wuchang. Carried: hopping jiangshi see 4 tiles, not 6.
item.wish_palm_fan.name: Palm fan
item.wish_palm_fan.desc: For King Yama. Carried: heat-shy cargo melts 30% slower, even in his hall.
item.wish_dive_mask.name: Dive mask
item.wish_dive_mask.desc: For Haenyeo Grandma. Carried: her dives last 5 s, not 8.
item.wish_pruning_shears.name: Pruning shears
item.wish_pruning_shears.desc: For Tangerine Auntie. Carried: the first damage to your cargo is ignored.
item.wish_lamp_wick.name: Lamp wick
item.wish_lamp_wick.desc: For Lighthouse Keeper. Carried: lights last twice as long and show hidden coins.
item.wish_satba.name: Satba belt
item.wish_satba.desc: For Goblin Chief. Carried: push 1 tile to win a wrestle.
buff.cart.name: Cart
buff.cart.desc: Big cargo moves faster: step time ×2 → ×1.4 for the whole run.
buff.energy_drink.name: Energy drink
buff.energy_drink.desc: Next two rooms: big-cargo step time ×2 → ×1.4.
buff.cooler.name: Cooler
buff.cooler.desc: Ice cream and fresh fish change half as fast.
buff.thermos.name: Thermos
buff.thermos.desc: Hot soup cools half as fast.
buff.padding.name: Padding
buff.padding.desc: Saves fragile cargo from one fall.
buff.waterproof.name: Dry bag
buff.waterproof.desc: Your cargo is safe from water.
buff.compass.name: Compass
buff.compass.desc: The minimap points to the recipient.
buff.running_shoes.name: Running shoes
buff.running_shoes.desc: Move 10% faster for the whole run.
buff.night_vision.name: Night vision
buff.night_vision.desc: +2 tiles of sight in the dark.
buff.lucky_charm.name: Lucky charm
shelf.rest.title: Rest stop
shelf.quit.title: Go home now?
shelf.quit.rule: 80% of your coins, rounded down to 5
shelf.quit.no_tip: No tip and no thank-you gift.
shelf.quit.wish: The wish gift ({name}) is left behind.
event.ghost_peddler.name: Ghost Peddler
event.ghost_peddler.text: A peddler with a spirit lantern on his pole. 3 goods at ×1.25, often rare ones.
event.forgetful_soup.name: Meng Po's Soup
event.forgetful_soup.text: Meng Po stirs a pot at the crossroads: "One bowl, one thing forgotten." Drink, and your cheapest item is gone.
event.lantern_riddle.name: Lantern Riddle
event.lantern_riddle.text: The answer is the wish gift of this order. Even a wrong guess gets a {snack}.
event.lantern_riddle.a_note: Right: wish gift at next fork
event.lantern_riddle.plain: You carry the wish gift: a plain riddle, 10 coins if right.
event.lost_parcel.name: Lost Parcel
event.lost_parcel.text: A parcel nobody came for lies by the road. The rain has blurred its label.
event.lost_parcel.a_note: Open it: maybe a wish gift
event.haunted_crate.name: Haunted Crate
event.haunted_crate.text: A crate shuffles about on its own. Something inside is knocking.
event.haunted_crate.b_note: Into the river, peace and quiet
shelf.restock.desc: New goods on the shelf. Each restock costs 5 more.
shelf.heal.desc: Heal one heart. The first time is free.
shelf.quit.desc: Go home now: keep 80% of your coins (rounded down to 5). No tip, no gift.
